svg.text: From Central Asia to Spain — within a century of 632
Muhammad died in 632 with power consolidated in Arabia. By about 750 the caliphate reached Spain, North Africa, Egypt, Syria, Iraq, Iran, Central Asia and Sindh.
Orange = approximate empire about a century later. Darker orange = Arabia at his death. Red labels = limits, not conquests.
Dates to say aloud: Spain 711 · Sindh 712 · Central Asia by the 710s · western raid stopped at Tours 732 · Constantinople was besieged and not taken.
Damascus became the Umayyad capital. Baghdad was founded in 762, after this century, so it is not on this map.
Shade is a classroom guide, not an exact frontier. Coastline: Natural Earth 1:110m, public domain. Equirectangular projection.
